title: Stray animals and Babies
content: There are several houses I find myself in during various visits. One of them is the 2 story house. The upper front side is broken down and exposed to the elements. It's always rainy and windy when I'm there. This house tends to attract stray animals. Like, a lot. Like the Bumpuses hounds, running to and from the house at will. My own dog is usually plating with them. And per real life, she doesn't come when I call her. As for babies, there are several babies who were not mine that I have breastfed and cared for. Anyone else?
